response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals, extensive experience, and a quality-driven mindset, he lacks the specific expertise required for this C++-centric industrial automation role. His career has diverged from systems programming into web/backend development, with negligible recent C++ experience (last significant work 9+ years ago at National Instruments), no demonstrated knowledge of industrial security standards (IEC 62443) or protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.), and minimal IoT/embedded systems background. The Node.js and testing expertise are valuable but insufficient to offset the domain gap for a mid-senior level position requiring deep C++ and industrial systems expertise.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience (20 years) with demonstrated progression to staff/senior levels and strong fundamentals in OOP, architecture, and technical problem-solving
Proven quality-driven mindset with TDD practices, creation of testing frameworks, and multiple workshops on software craftsmanship and testing methodology
Strong communication and knowledge-sharing skills, evidenced by technical talks, open-source contributions, and mentoring initiatives across multiple organizations
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience with last significant systems work limited to 6 months at National Instruments (2014-2015); current focus is TypeScript and Node.js, indicating skills decay in required language
No demonstrated knowledge of industrial automation domain, IoT application development, industrial protocols (Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC UA), or security standards (IEC 62443, SDL practices)

Career trajectory shows divergence from systems/embedded programming toward web and backend services, suggesting potential difficulties with performance-critical, real-time industrial systems development

key_factors.factor: C++ expertise and systems programming depth
Industrial automation and IoT domain knowledge
Software engineering fundamentals and learning capacity
